description: What the TinyNet golden programs (zo_model_tiny.pte, zo_model_tiny_infer.pte, tinynet_trainable.pte) need from a runtime, recorded here so scripts/stage_model_bundle.py can stay stdlib-only. framework/tests/test_stage_model_bundle.py reads the staged programs with ExecuTorch and fails if requiredOperators is not exactly their operator set.

resourceEnvelope.basis: Declared budgets, not measurements. TinyNet has 43 parameters and trains on one 8x4 batch, so these bound it generously; portable-CPU qualification measures a device against them. Storage is the staged model files' total size.
